On 12/06/2018, the FBI New York Child Exploitation and Human Trafficking Task Force (FBI-NY
CEHTTF) initiated a child sex trafficking case following a request by the United States Attorneys
Office, Southern District of New York (SDNY), based on several victims that had been sexually abused
by JEFFREY EPSTEIN (Epstein) in the mid-2000's. Epstein was indicted on 07/02/2019 and arrested
on 07/06/2019. On 08/10/2019, FBI-NY was notified Epstein committed suicide in his jail cell. The child
sex trafficking investigation continued to pursue co-conspirators, including GHISLAINE MAXWELL
(Maxwell).

Maxwell was first mentioned in the case file on 04/23/2019. Victim interviews revealed Maxwell
groomed minor victims by befriending them first, developed a rapport with victims, then attempted to
normalize sexual abuse. Maxwell was present with the minor victims while victims were undressed in
front of Epstein and instructed minor victims on how to massage Epstein, to include sexual contact.

Note: SDNY proffered Maxwell with her Defense counsel prior to indictment.

On 06/29/2020, Maxwell was indicted on five counts, as follows:
Count 1: Conspiracy to entice minors
Count 2: Enticement of a minor
Count 3: Conspiracy to transport minors
Count 4: Transportation of a minor
Count 5: Two counts of Perjury

On 03/29/2021, a Grand Jury in SDNY issued a superseding indictment against Maxwell with the
following counts:

Count 1: Conspiracy to entice minors
Count 2: Enticement of a Minor to Travel to Engage in Illegal Sex Acts
Count 3: Conspiracy to Transport Minors with Intent to Engage in Criminal Sexual Activity
Count 4: Transportation of a Minor with Intent to Engage in Criminal Sexual Activity
Count 5: Sex Trafficking Conspiracy
Count 6: Sex Trafficking of a Minor
Count 7: Perjury

On 07/02/2020, pursuant to an arrest warrant issued in SDNY, FBI-NY CEHTTF and FBI Boston
located and arrested Maxwell at 338 East Washington Road, Bradford, New Hampshire.


On 11/29/2021, the trial of United States v. Ghislaine Maxwell began in the SDNY before the Honorable Alison
Nathan. Maxwell did not testify during the trial. The defense alleged Maxwell was targeted for the crimes
committed by Epstein, Maxwell was unaware of the abuse of minor victims by Epstein because he kept secrets
from Maxwell, credibility issues among some of the victims, and victims were financially motivated by the
victims compensation fund.




                                                                                                 EFTA01648957
 On 12/29/2021, a jury found Maxwell guilty on five of the six counts. The verdict was as follows:

Not guilty.

    • Count 2: Enticement of a Minor to Travel to Engage in Illegal Sex Acts

Guilty

   • Count 1: Conspiracy to Entice Minors to Travel to Engage in Illegal Sex Acts
   • Count 3: Conspiracy to Transport Minors with Intent to Engage in Criminal Sexual Activity
   • Count 4: Transportation of a Minor with Intent to Engage in Criminal Sexual Activity
   • Count 5: Sex Trafficking Conspiracy
   • Count 6: Sex Trafficking of a Minor

Note: Count 7 (Perjury) was not litigated during this trial.



On 06/28/2022, Maxwell was sentenced to 20 years in prison with 5 years of supervised release, and a $750,000
fine for participating and facilitating the sexual abuse and sex trafficking of minors for and with Jeffrey Epstein.


On or about 04/10/2025, Maxwell petitioned to file a Writ of Certiorari with the Supreme Court.
